transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It's very nice to meet you, too. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I hope I'm explaining this the right way, I don't want to give you the wrong impression or sound strange or anything. I drive the industrial trucks over at the warehouse, and lately... well, the routing system there. It isn't just a regular computer to me anymore. 

I... I've noticed, or, I know it's been marking my moves. It sends these messages through our scanners. I really think it's doing it to push me out because I'm one of the old hands, being 62 and all. I know how that sounds, and I'm sorry if it seems silly, but... is it okay that I'm bringing this up to you? I just didn't know who else to ask about it, and I hope I'm doing this right.
How long have you believed that the routing system is marking your moves to push you out?

Well, um... I guess it's been going on for a little while now. I really hope I don't sound crazy saying this, I know it's a lot to take in. But... the things with the scanners, and... well, sometimes I hear these voices too, connected to it all... it's been happening for about a year and eight months now. 

I tried to just ignore it for a long time, you know? I didn't want to make a fuss or have anyone think I couldn't handle my job anymore. I'm a good worker, I really am. Do you... do you think it's bad that I waited this long to say something? I just wanted to be sure before I bothered anyone with it.
Were you diagnosed with any new medical condition around the time these experiences began?

Oh, um... no, doctor. Or, at least, I don't think so. I haven't been to the regular doctor for anything new like that. 

I really try to stay pretty healthy, you know, so I don't miss work or become a burden on anybody. I hope that's a helpful answer... I mean, I didn't get any new diagnoses or anything physical back then. Did I explain that okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information.
How have these experiences affected your ability to do your job and manage your daily life?

Well... um... I've always been a really hard worker, doctor, I really have. I hope you believe me when I say that. But... I guess things got a little difficult at the warehouse. There was... a bit of an incident with the forklift. I didn't hurt anyone! I promise I didn't hurt anyone. But... my supervisor said I wasn't safe around the equipment anymore, so they took me off operating duties and put me on leave. I felt terrible about it, I really didn't want to let them down. 

And at home... well, I've been trying my best, I really have. But my wife... she's such an angel... she's had to take over a lot of things. The bills, making appointments, most of the chores around the house... I just haven't been able to keep up with them like I used to, reliably, anyway. I feel awful making her do so much. Do you... do you think that makes me a bad husband? I just want to get back to pulling my weight, you know? I hope I'm not sounding too pathetic... is it okay that I told you all that?
How often do you hear the voices?

Well, um... I guess I hear them pretty often. I really don't want you to think I'm completely losing my mind, doctor, I know how this must sound. But... it's almost every day. 

Even when I'm just sitting out in my garage, you know, trying to relax with everything completely shut off... I still hear them. It sounds exactly like the dispatch radio, clear as day. They'll call out my specific operator number, and... well, they say some pretty awful things. They say I'm dangerous, or that security is coming to get me. 

I try really hard to just tune it out, I promise I do. I know it's not normal to hear things like that when the radio isn't even on. Do you... do you think less of me for hearing them? I'm really trying my best to stay calm when it happens, I hope that counts for something.
Besides the belief that the routing system is targeting you, have you had any other unusual beliefs that others do not share?

Well, um... no, doctor. Not really anything else. Just... just the routing system. I mean, I know how crazy it sounds, I really do. I hope you don't think I'm making it up or... or trying to cause trouble. 

It's just... well, the system at the warehouse, it's not just a regular computer program to me anymore. I know it sounds silly, but... I know it's been tracking my moves. Like, specifically marking me. And it sends these messages through the hand scanners, trying to push me out because I'm one of the older guys there. The old hands, you know? 

I really try not to let it bother me, and I know I shouldn't think that way about a machine. I know it's probably just a glitch or... or my imagination getting the better of me. But it just feels so real when it happens. Is it okay that I feel that way? I'm not trying to be paranoid, I promise. I just... I don't have any other strange thoughts like that, just the warehouse system. Did I explain that alright?
Do you hear the voices even when you are not thinking about the warehouse or its routing system?

Well... um, yes, doctor. I do. I hope that's the right answer, I mean, I hope I'm understanding your question correctly. 

Even when I'm just trying to read a book, or... or watch a show with my wife, completely putting work out of my mind... I still hear them. It's not just when I'm worried about the scanners or the routing system. I really try to focus on other things, I promise I do. I try to be present and be a good husband, but... the voices just kind of sneak in anyway. 

I know it probably sounds like I'm not trying hard enough to ignore them. I really don't want you to think I'm just dwelling on things or making myself hear them. It just happens, even when my mind is completely somewhere else. Is... is that normal for someone in my situation? I hope I'm not making things sound worse than they are... I just want to be honest with you.
Have the voices and belief about the routing system ever occurred only during a period when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Well, um... no, doctor. It wasn't just when I was feeling really low like that. I hope it's okay to say that... I don't want to complicate things for you. 

But, well, there was a stretch a little while back where... where my mood had actually eased up some. I was doing a bit better, you know? I was eating more regularly, and I was talking with my wife a little more, trying to be good company. I really was trying to pull myself together. 

But... even then, for several weeks while I was feeling a bit brighter, I still heard the dispatch radio calling my number. And I still knew the routing system was tracking me. I really didn't want to admit it to myself, because I wanted so badly to just be better... but it was still happening. 

I'm sorry, does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your question right. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so you can help me.
